title: Front-bumper repair Honda Activa
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00412. Date of loss 2026-02-11. Own-damage front bumper damage after low-speed collision with a divider. Excess/deductible Rs 1500. Assessor notes no engine damage, no third-party involvement. Recommended: repair only front bumper unit. Exclusions reviewed: collision damage is covered under own damage; no exclusion applies.

title: Water-ingress engine claim
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00418. Date of loss 2026-03-02. Policyholder rode through flooded road and engine water ingress reported. Excess Rs 2500. Engine Protector add-on was NOT purchased. Under exclusion clause Exc-7.4 engine damage from water ingress is excluded unless Engine Protector add-on present. Recommend denial.

title: Rear-end collision
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00425. Date of loss 2026-01-19. Rear-end collision at low speed. Excess Rs 1800. Rear bumper and number-plate bracket damaged. No injuries. Both parties insured with us.

title: Drink-driving refusal
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00431. Date of loss 2026-02-27. Vehicle found driven while under influence after accident; police report flags alcohol. Under exclusion clause Exc-5.1 any claim arising while driver intoxicated is excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Tree-branch storm damage
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00444. Tree branch fell on parked car during storm. Excess Rs 2200. Roof dent and windshield crack. Policyholder reports event occurred during the second week of March. Exact date to be confirmed from police FIR.

title: Theft of aftermarket stereo
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00455. Date of loss 2026-04-02. Undeclared aftermarket stereo unit stolen; vehicle not otherwise damaged. Notes state undeclared non-OEM parts such as stereos are not covered unless declared in advance. Recommend partial: vehicle theft covered, aftermarket item excluded.

title: Hail damage
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00462. Date of loss 2026-05-05. Hailstorm dented hood and roof. Excess approximately two thousand rupees per claim per the schedule. Assessor confirms coverage under own damage. No exclusions.

title: Unlicensed-driver accident
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00471. Date of loss 2026-03-18. Accident while vehicle driven by a person without a valid driving licence. Notes confirm driver not named on policy. Under exclusion clause Exc-2.2 claims arising from unlicensed drivers are excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Multi-claim dispute
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00480. Date of loss 2026-02-08. Two separate events claimed under one policy: a parking scrape (own damage) and a later bumper crack. Excess Rs 2000 applies per event. First event covered; second event under investigation pending assessor photos. Any payout subject to both events being confirmed.

title: Windshield replacement
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00493. Date of loss 2026-04-11. Stone chip cracked windshield. Excess Rs 1500. Windshield replacement approved under comprehensive glass cover. No exclusions.

title: Tyres and tubes damage
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00504. Date of loss 2026-05-29. Policyholder reports punctured front and rear tyres. Notes explicitly state tyres and tubes are not covered by the policy unless damaged along with vehicle in an accident; here they failed in normal use. Under exclusion Exc-8.1 tyres/tubes damage not concurrent with vehicle accident is excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Rear bumper theft
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00511. Rear bumper section stolen overnight. Excess Rs 2200. Theft occurred sometime over the weekend but no police report logged yet; loss date to be confirmed on FIR. Vehicle otherwise intact.

title: Usage in commercial service
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00528. Date of loss 2026-04-27. Vehicle damaged while being used as a commercial ride-hailing vehicle, contrary to private-use schedule. Under exclusion clause Exc-3.3 use for commercial carrying of passengers is excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Single-vehicle rollover
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00536. Date of loss 2026-06-01. Single-vehicle rollover on gravel shoulder; driver escaped unhurt. Excess Rs 2500. Own damage covers repairs estimating Rs 60,000. No third-party damage.

title: Fire and explosion
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00549. Date of loss 2026-06-14. Engine-bay fire caused by electrical short. Excess approximately one thousand five hundred rupees. Fire cover under own damage. Assessor recommends full repair.

title: Third-party fence damage
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00552. Date of loss 2026-05-20. Driver hit a neighbour's fence causing property damage. Own vehicle undamaged. Excess Rs 1000 for own damage not applicable as no own-damage claim. Third-party liability settled.

title: Claim after policy lapse
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00567. Date of loss 2026-04-30. Damage occurred three days after the policy term lapsed (policy expired 2027-06-10; prior. Notes confirm no reinstatement on record). Under exclusion Exc-1.1 loss occurring outside the period of insurance is excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Engine protector add-on confusion
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00573. Date of loss 2026-06-20. Water ingress on flooding; policyholder believes Engine Protector add-on covers it. Notes confirm the add-on was NOT selected at inception and the schedule lists no Engine Protector. Exclusion Exc-7.4 applies. Recommend denial.

title: Collision with animal
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00581. Date of loss 2026-07-03. Hit a stray cow at night; front grille and headlamp damaged. Excess Rs 1800. Own damage covered; animal damage not separately claimable.

title: Conveying goods claim
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00596. Date of loss 2026-07-11. Vehicle damaged while conveying heavy goods beyond schedule limit. Notes state private-use policy with a goods-carrying exclusion. Under exclusion clause Exc-4.2 conveying goods for hire is excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Vandalism report
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00604. Date of loss not yet determined; vandalism (scratched paint across both doors) discovered on morning of 2026-07-27. Excess Rs 1500. Policyholder unsure when the damage occurred. FIR pending.

title: Natural-disaster flood
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00612. Date of loss 2026-07-30. Floodwater submerged parked vehicle; electrical system and interior damaged. Excess Rs 2200. Flood is covered under natural-disaster own damage, but engine water ingress needs Engine Protector add-on; policyholder does NOT have it. Recommend partial: cover body/flood damage, exclude engine ingress.

title: Half-yearly scrape
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00623. Date of loss 2026-08-04. Minor door scrape in carpark; no note left. Excess Rs 1500. Own damage covered. No third-party.

title: Unauthorized overnight use
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00631. Date of loss 2026-08-09. Vehicle ran off road while being driven by a family member not on the permitted-list without consent. Assessment pending. Under exclusion clause Exc-2.4 use by an unpermitted driver without consent is excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Side mirror collision
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00646. Date of loss 2026-08-15. Scraped side mirror against pillar; mirror casing cracked, glass intact. Excess Rs 1500. Own damage covered. Assessor recommends repair of mirror assembly only.

title: Racing incident
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00652. Date of loss 2026-08-18. Vehicle damaged during an organised car-racing event on a closed track. Use for racing/speed events is excluded. Under exclusion clause Exc-6.1 loss during speed trials or racing is wholly excluded. Recommend denial.

title: Rear-window replacement
adjuster_notes: Claim CLM-2026-00663. Date of loss 2026-08-22. Rear window shattered by thrown object. Excess in the region of one thousand eight hundred rupees. Glass cover applies. No exclusions.
